asset: CABS Tier 5 wholesale access billing reference estate
purpose: Declares what is compared, how records are keyed, which REDEFINES overlay is decoded, where a tolerance is permitted and why, and how the control chain is expected to hold. This file is an input to the comparison. It contains no answers.
principles: Decimal comparison is exact by default. A tolerance exists only where this file declares one, and every declared tolerance carries a reason.
A key must be a business key, not a physical one. Record position is not a key.
Exactly one REDEFINES overlay is decoded per record. The variant_rule says which.
Filler and variant-area group items are excluded from field comparison because the overlay already covers those bytes; they are still compared as bytes at L1 through the record hash.

parameters.note: cycle_start/cycle_end are YYDDD. Override with --cycle-start / --cycle-end on run_compare.py when comparing a different cycle.

datasets.name: USAGE.RAW
datasets.description: Raw wholesale access usage, one GDG generation per day. DD RAWIN on CABING01.

variant_rule.note: CD-REC-TYPE '03' satisfies both CD-VOICE-MOU and CD-DATA-SVC, and '05' satisfies both CD-DATA-SVC and CD-SPECIAL-ACC. The 88-levels overlap in the frozen copybook. This mapping resolves the ambiguity the same way for both sides, which is the only way the comparison can be meaningful; that the ambiguity exists at all is a finding for the modernization, recorded here rather than hidden.

datasets.tolerance_note: None. Usage quantities are exact. A sub-unit tolerance here would hide exactly the class of difference this level exists to find, which is how such differences survive in a production estate.

datasets.name: USAGE.CLEAN
datasets.description: The billable usage stream leaving CABING05.

datasets.name: USAGE.RATED
datasets.description: Rated usage leaving the RATING family.

datasets.name: CONTROL
datasets.description: Run control and balancing records, written by every process at every boundary.

datasets.name: BILLHDR
datasets.description: Invoice header. The record the bill-to-bill comparison keys on.
datasets.tolerance_note: None, deliberately. The estate's own account-level proof applies a tolerance to itself; reproducing that tolerance here would reproduce whatever it has been absorbing and leave this level unable to fail.

datasets.name: BILLDTL
datasets.description: Bill detail lines, variable length, OCCURS DEPENDING ON BD-ELEM-CNT.

datasets.name: SETTLEMENT
datasets.description: Inter-carrier settlement records: meet point, reciprocal compensation and CMDS/RAO. The pattern deliberately excludes TELCABS.SETL.CMDS.IN, which is the 180-byte industry exchange format declared in CABSET07/CABSET08 working storage rather than in a copybook; it has no CABSSETL layout and is reconciled by its own HD/TR trailer totals, not here.

l3.note: An out-of-balance legacy run is a finding about the legacy. It is not a reason to skip the assertion, and CT-BAL-IND = 'O' being routine in operations is not a reason either.

process_chain.note: the generator declares what it produced; CABING01 must read exactly that
CABING05 writes the clean stream. If the count on either side of this edge is inflated the edge breaks, which is the point of declaring it.
the summary sort sits between these two and writes no control record; a divergence arising in that gap has no control record on either side to expose it

l4.note: BH-HASH-AMOUNT carries five decimals and BD-TOT-ROUNDED carries two. They are compared separately and never against each other: comparing two different precisions under a tolerance is how a control stops being able to fail.

assertions: ST-OUR-PCT + ST-THEIR-PCT = 100.00000 for every meet-point record
ST-OUR-SHARE + ST-THEIR-SHARE = ST-GROSS-AMT for every meet-point record
l5.note: Both assertions are needed. The split reconciling is not evidence that the percentages are right -- CABSET01 makes the split reconcile by adjusting our percentage.

reporting.note: A cap on what is listed, not on what is counted. The stats block always reports the full count and flags truncation.
